description: This file contains extension methods for accessing Orleans stream providers from grains, clients, and grain base classes, facilitating dependency injection and stream provider retrieval by name.

classes.name: GrainStreamingExtensions
classes.description: Provides extension methods for retrieving stream providers from Grain and IGrainBase instances.

classes.name: ClientStreamingExtensions
classes.description: Provides extension methods for retrieving stream providers from IClusterClient instances.

methods.name: GetStreamProvider
methods.description: Retrieves an IStreamProvider instance associated with a Grain, IGrainBase, or IClusterClient by name, with null or whitespace name throwing ArgumentNullException.
